region.lead: Pick a settlement, or explore the whole region on the map.

overview.eyebrow: For councils, tourist offices and local businesses
overview.title: Visitors find your places and events on one map
overview.lead: Places, events and the map sit on one page. The guest opens it on a phone and sets off.
overview.differenceTitle: The lesser-known place gets visitors too
overview.differenceLead: The workshop, the cellar and the side street are on the map. Whoever runs the place writes their own page. The council or the office passes it on with one link.
overview.seoTitle: HelloLocal | Local places, makers and areas on one map
overview.seoDescription: Makers, local services and the less visible places, on one map. For councils, tourist offices and the people who are not on the main street.
overview.keywords: local business, maker, local service, village, region, municipality, tourist office, HelloLocal
overview.shotCaption: Szeged on the map: places, filters and the next events on one screen.
overview.statsApp: the guest opens it in the browser
overview.featuresLead: Opening hours, what is on today, and the place that sits off the main square.

hidden.title: What only locals used to know
hidden.text: A courtyard, a workshop, a market table, a cellar, one corner further in. It goes on the map, and the guest can find it.

traffic.title: Visitors from a small ad budget
traffic.text: The council or the office link brings people in. The advertising budget can stay small.

region.title: One region, separate maps
region.text: Several settlements can sit side by side, each with its own audience. A maker stays with their own area.

overview.storiesLead: For the maker, the local service, and the council or office that passes them on to the guest with one link.
overview.closingTitle: The next guest starts from the map.
overview.closingText: Open it and picture your own places on those dots: the workshop, the cellar, the service, or the whole area.
overview.closingImageAlt: A hiker with a yellow backpack on a mountain trail

collect.title: Whoever was missing gets a place
collect.text: A workshop, a shop, a cellar, a service. A photo, opening hours, and a page the guest can forward.

publish.title: The programme stays current
publish.text: The coming weeks sit beside the map. What has ended drops off, and this weekend stays in front.

share.title: One link for the guest
share.text: They open it in their own language, filter, and set off. It works in the phone's browser.

app.q: Does a guest have to download an app?
app.a: The map and the events open in the browser, on a phone and on a computer.

languages.q: Is there a separate page for each language?
languages.a: Each language the guest arrives in gets its own address. Search can then find the page in that language.

editors.a: Whoever runs the place: the maker, the service, or someone at the council or the office. Each looks after their own part. An AI generator writes with them, and analytics shows the traffic.

towns.q: Can several settlements share one system?
towns.a: Yes. A region can hold several settlements. Each has its own map and programme, and the guest stays with the one they opened.

places.title: The workshop can be found too
places.text: It goes on the map with opening hours and a page the guest can forward. The lesser-known place shows up as well.

events.title: This weekend stays in front
events.text: What has ended comes off. What is on now is what the guest sees first.

map.title: A map you can set off from
map.text: The guest sees what is open, what works in the rain, and what is on today. The map stays usable on a phone.

languages.title: The guest reads it in their own language
languages.text: The content is written in the guest's language, on that language's address. They get the same map.

sites.title: Several settlements, separate programmes
sites.text: A region can hold more than one place. Each map and programme stays separate, so the guest does not slip into the next village.

editors.title: Whoever runs the place writes it
editors.text: The maker, the service or the local staff looks after their own text. They can draft it with an AI generator, and they can see the traffic. The guest sees what is true right now.

maker.title: The workshop gets its own page
maker.text: Ceramics, linen, jam, honey. A photo, opening hours, and a pin the guest can forward.
maker.alt: Handmade ceramic bowls on a workshop table

service.title: Their own name comes first
service.text: A hairdresser, a tailor, a bicycle workshop, a massage. The guest looks at the area and sees their name and their address.
service.alt: A small bicycle workshop with tools and a wheel on the bench

quiet.title: One corner further in
quiet.text: A courtyard, a workshop, a market table, a turn off the main street. The places only locals used to know go on the map too.
quiet.alt: An open courtyard gate on a quiet side street

town.title: The one that can gather them
town.text: It gathers the local businesses and hands the visitor one link, in the visitor's language.
town.alt: A live map of local places and events
